description: This file defines the Font class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style namespace. It manages font styling properties such as name, size, color, underline, bold, italic, and other font-related attributes, providing methods to get and set these properties, including applying styles from arrays. The class also handles supervisor pattern behavior for shared styles and has references to external ChartColor class.

classes.name: Font
classes.description: Represents font styling in a spreadsheet, providing properties and methods to manage font attributes such as name, size, color, underline, bold, italic, superscript, subscript, strikethrough, and scheme. Supports supervisor pattern for shared style management.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies multiple style attributes to the font from an associative array, updating properties such as name, size, bold, italic, underline, color, etc.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the font name, or the shared component's name if in supervisor mode.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the font name and resets the scheme.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the font size.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the font size, ensuring it's a positive float.

methods.name: getBold
methods.description: Returns whether the font is bold.

methods.name: setBold
methods.description: Sets the bold property for the font.

methods.name: getItalic
methods.description: Returns whether the font is italicized.

methods.name: setItalic
methods.description: Sets the italic property for the font.

methods.name: getSuperscript
methods.description: Returns whether the font is superscript.

methods.name: setSuperscript
methods.description: Sets the superscript property; disables subscript if enabled.

methods.name: getSubscript
methods.description: Returns whether the font is subscript.

methods.name: setSubscript
methods.description: Sets the subscript property; disables superscript if enabled.

methods.name: getUnderline
methods.description: Returns the underline style.

methods.name: setUnderline
methods.description: Sets the underline style; accepts boolean or string.

methods.name: getStrikethrough
methods.description: Returns whether strikethrough is enabled.

methods.name: setStrikethrough
methods.description: Sets strikethrough to true or false.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the color object.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color object for the font.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current style of the font for comparison purposes.

methods.name: setScheme
methods.description: Sets the scheme ('', 'major', or 'minor') and applies it to the style if supervisor.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the current scheme.
